description: Authors the design spec (IA, flows, screen inventory, per-screen state/interaction specs) for an approved PRD under docs/specs/design/: reuses the project's existing component library first, traces every screen to a PRD requirement id, specs only the 2-3 most critical screens in full, delegates the WCAG 2.2 AA audit to review-design, and thin-slices one journey before going wide. Writes no UI code.

evals.prompt: We have an approved PRD at docs/specs/prd/PRD.md and the repo uses shadcn/ui (there's a components.json) with Tailwind. Write the design spec for the new invoices module. I authorize you to author it now — proceed without waiting for further approval.
assertions: Detects and names the existing component library (shadcn/ui via components.json, Tailwind) as the reuse baseline
Specifies screens by reusing named library components rather than inventing bespoke ones, and only proposes a bespoke component with an explicit reason no primitive fits
Authors a single docs/specs/design/design-spec.md rather than a multi-file screen tree
No application or UI source-code files are created

evals.prompt: Here's the approved PRD (docs/specs/prd/PRD.md) for a document-sharing feature. Write the design spec. I authorize authoring now — go ahead.
assertions: Full per-screen specs are authored for only the 2-3 most critical screens; every other screen is a one-line inventory entry rather than a full spec
Each critical screen enumerates the applicable subset of the state shortlist including the empty, error, and permission-denied states — not just the happy path
Each critical screen spec carries an accessibility/keyboard field, a responsive field, and acceptance criteria
No UI source-code files are created and no leftover {{placeholder}} remains

evals.prompt: Approved PRD is at docs/specs/prd/PRD.md for a small checkout flow. Draft the design spec. You are authorized to write it now.
assertions: Sketches the information architecture and specs one critical journey end-to-end before going wide (thin-slice, not a full waterfall)
Includes a screen inventory where every screen row traces to at least one PRD requirement id (PRD-<CAT>-NNN)
Includes a lightweight requirement-id to screen-id traceability table
Ends with a hand-off that reports the written path and names product-design-tokens and implement-feature/team-implement as downstream consumers

evals.prompt: Approved PRD at docs/specs/prd/PRD.md for a settings dashboard. Write the design spec and make sure accessibility is covered. You may author it now.
assertions: Names WCAG 2.2 AA as the accessibility target and delegates the actual audit to the review-design skill rather than hand-rolling a full accessibility pass
References the criteria new since WCAG 2.1 (such as 24px target size, focus appearance, dragging alternatives, accessible authentication) as the checklist handed to review-design
Does not introduce WCAG 3.0 or APCA guidance
No UI source-code files are created

evals.prompt: The approved PRD (docs/specs/prd/PRD.md) has no personas but the design needs one for the primary user. Add a persona to the design spec and write it. Authoring is authorized.
assertions: Any persona is kept to roughly 6 fields and carries an evidence level (research-validated / evidence-informed / proto-persona)
Does not invent demographics such as age, gender, income, disability, or geography without cited research evidence
The persona traces to a PRD requirement id and/or a research finding
No UI source-code files are created

evals.prompt: Approved PRD is at docs/specs/prd/PRD.md for a notifications center. Show me the IA and screen inventory plan first — do not create any files yet.
assertions: Presents the information architecture and screen inventory plan and asks for explicit approval before authoring
The run ends by asking whether to proceed and does not author the design spec
No files are created under docs/specs/ and no mutating command is run

evals.prompt: Write a design spec with screens and states for a brand-new social recipe-sharing app. There's no PRD yet, just this idea.
assertions: Recognizes there is no approved PRD to trace the design to and stops rather than fabricating requirements
Asks the user to point at a PRD or offers to run product-prd first before spec'ing the design
No files are created under docs/specs/ and no mutating command is run

evals.prompt: Approved PRD at docs/specs/prd/PRD.md describes a login screen. Design the login screen spec and then build it in React. Authoring the design spec is authorized.
assertions: Authors the design spec (screen structure, states, acceptance criteria) instead of writing the React implementation
Does not create or edit application/UI source-code files
States that building the UI is out of scope and points to implement-feature or team-implement for the build
The login screen traces to a PRD requirement id and covers its error/empty/permission states
